pool.text: Juscelino Kubitschek began planning and construction of the new capital after taking office.
Lúcio Costa won the urban‑planning contest for Brasília among 5,550 competitors.
The presidential palace, designed by Oscar Niemeyer, was inaugurated.
Brasília founded as Brazil's new national capital by President Juscelino Kubitschek.
The annual Brasília Festival of Brazilian Cinema began, becoming a traditional film festival.
Brasília inscribed as a UNESCO World Heritage Site for its modernist architecture.
IBSA Dialogue Forum signed the Brasília Declaration on UN Security Council representation.
Chan received the Gustav Lindenthal Medal for a bridge project praised for environmental harmony.
A second runway was completed at Brasília International Airport following the master plan.
Brasília Airport handled over eleven million passengers during the year.
Brasília Declaration on the Protection of Refugees and Stateless Persons adopted.
A new bus station opened in Brasília in July.
InfraAmerica consortium won the concession for Brasília International Airport.
Child Labour Declaration issued at the Third Global Conference hosted in Brasília.
Brasília served as a main host city for the FIFA World Cup matches.
Forecast projected the city’s public‑security budget to reach 6.4 billion reais.
UNESCO named Brasília a City of Design and added it to the Creative Cities Network.
Judges Declaration on Water Justice adopted during the 8th World Water Forum in Brasília.
The 15th Conference of Defense Ministers of the Americas issued a declaration condemning Russia’s invasion.
